_comment: The declarative skill table (skill-server migration). Replaces the deleted Goal/RobotState/Transitions/Superstructure. Each scoring-axis skill names — by reference, never by embedded math — its per-mechanism setpoint SOURCE (resolved in Setpoints / TurretAiming), its indexer FEED mode (resolved in IndexerFeed), the REFLEXES that gate/override it (feedGate, passGate, clearing, turretTracking, staleness — resolved in the Reflexes library), a DONE predicate (resolved in DonePredicates — 'never' or 'feeding'; advisory status only, never auto-cancels), an OPTIONAL status 'timeoutSeconds' (instrumentation only: when a firing skill spends longer than this trying to reach the feeding phase the interpreter reports BLOCKED — it NEVER cancels the skill or changes a mechanism command; absent = never blocks), and whether it is cancelable. The intake axis is orthogonal to scoring and runs every loop via the intake reflex. Schema-validated at load with a safe fallback (see SkillTable): an invalid table forces a hardcoded safe-idle (everything off/hold, intake stowed) and reports a DriverStation error.
